steps: Install the isolated provider contract probe without MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

expected_result: All 12 required public Provider operations pass, probe objects are removed, and build identities are recorded without treating the public API result as a production adapter profile or bit 17 observation

reviewer_conclusion: The alioth Android 13 public Provider baseline is complete and permits T-35 Host contract work.
